# poli

Source: [poli](https://github.com/MachineLearningLifeScience/poli).

Role: runtime.

Black-box interface for LaMBO-2. Installed only in the Python 3.10 environment by setup --lambo2.

Pinned commit: `bc38921a51cbb28b835e34a785e830f3ef3b9eb7`. To inspect this exact version inside this folder:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MachineLearningLifeScience/poli.git external/poli/source
git -C external/poli/source checkout --detach bc38921a51cbb28b835e34a785e830f3ef3b9eb7
```

The source checkout is optional and ignored by Git. See the upstream LICENSE and notices at the pinned revision before redistributing source. This folder documents provenance; it does not replace upstream attribution.
